title: Causal replay integrity hardening verified and merged
summary: A current-main subsystem audit repaired three causal-integrity defects: PARALLAX now fails closed on contradictory same-time axis observations and correctly honors one-shot generator masks; ATHENA returns deep copies from its append-only advisory journal so callers cannot mutate nested stored evidence; ARGUS now accepts causally late authenticated trades only for explicitly unsequenced sources while preserving strict event-time monotonicity for sequenced feeds. Exact-head Linux/Windows subsystem CI, the intelligence-fabric gate, and full-system validation passed before merge. The changes remain research/advisory only.
